name: NM-01
label: Safe D

key_factors: District's 7-point Democratic lean plus a favorable national environment
Incumbency and Polymarket pricing the race at 96% Democratic
model.rationale: The fundamentals point strongly to Stansbury: a D+7 district, an incumbent who outraised her opponent by more than 13-to-1, and prediction markets pricing her near certain. With no contrary polling or ratings, the forecast stays at a roughly 20-point Democratic margin.
model.watch: A late surge of outside Republican spending or an unusually strong GOP environment in New Mexico could narrow the margin, though not likely the outcome.
notes: No expert rater lists this race; treated as safe for the party holding the seat.
No usable general-election polls; forecast rests on fundamentals and expert ratings.

overview:
Melanie Stansbury, the Democratic incumbent, seeks another term in a Albuquerque-based district that leans Democratic by about seven points. She has raised over $1.3 million and holds more than $400,000 on hand, with modest outside support and no recorded opposition spending. Republican challenger Didi Okpareke has raised about $100,000, leaving a steep financial gap.

No public general-election polls or expert ratings cover the race, so expectations rest on district fundamentals, incumbency, and money. Prediction markets put Stansbury's chances around 96 percent. The race is rated Safe Democratic, with an expected margin near 20 points and moderate uncertainty given the absence of polling.
